description:
Retro-Stretch 3-Speed Cruiser
The Micargi Boston 3I DS is a remarkable cruiser bicycle that seamlessly marries classic design elements with modern performance features. While sharing its heritage with the Boston GT7, the Boston 3I DS offers a distinct riding experience tailored to those who value simplicity and elegance in their biking endeavors.
At the heart of the Boston 3I DS lies a timeless 3-speed internal hub system that promotes a smooth and hassle-free ride. Unlike its counterpart, the Boston GT7, which boasts a 7-speed gear range, the Boston 3I DS focuses on a simpler approach to gearing, ideal for those who prioritize comfort and straightforward cycling. This 3-speed configuration is perfect for leisurely rides around town and casual outings.
Similar to the Boston GT7, the Boston 3I DS features the signature Micargi 26" Chopper Stretch Hi-ten Steel frame, lending the bicycle an elongated silhouette that exudes a sense of uniqueness. The triple tree aluminum dual crown fork with a disc brake enhances not only the bicycle's appearance but also ensures steady handling and shock absorption, guaranteeing a comfortable ride.
While the Boston 3I DS might not offer the extensive gear range of the GT7, it compensates by emphasizing a different kind of riding experience. The mechanical disc brakes with a 160mm rotor provide dependable stopping power, instilling confidence in every ride. The alloy FAT wheels, equipped with INNOVA FAT Black white wall tires measuring 26”x3.0, maintain the bicycle's stability and traction, making it an excellent option for light off-road exploration and urban cruising alike.
Comfort remains a priority on the Boston 3I DS, exemplified by its Micargi Steel Hi-Rise handlebar and a thoughtfully designed saddle. The saddle's construction, featuring vacuum elastic PVC leather and high-density PU foam with springs, guarantees a pleasurable ride, even during extended journeys.
